_comment: Validated P-017 golf pod parameters from backtest_golf.py + refine_golf.py, H1-2026 Kalshi data (10 tournaments; Leg B 4 tournaments of tick data). THOC26/COPC26 excluded (settlement lag on pull date). edge_bump values are the CONSERVATIVE lower-CI convention (matching qualifier_favorite_pod P-015), NOT point estimates. Regenerate after each new event via re-pull + backtest.

leg_A_pre_tourn_taker.notes: top-20 (+8.3c) stronger than top-10 (+4.9c); band-robust +6.6..+7.4c. Exclude signature-event weeks initially (TRAV26 exception). fair_prob = min(ask + edge_bump, cap); with DataGolf later, replace edge_bump with model prob.

leg_B_fade_maker.notes: REAL edge but only 4 tournaments of tick data. CRITICAL: window must start at 36h, NOT 48h. The 48-24h slice is NEGATIVE (-3.1c) - fading Friday loses because YES is still climbing; edge is Sat->Sun-AM. offset 0.03 minimizes adverse selection. Deploy paper-only to confirm before any real money.

leg_C_makecut.notes: Only 12 two-sided pre-tournament make-cut quotes in sample (median ask 0.36, clustered 0.3-0.7). Cannot validate. Revisit after live paper collection.

rejected.top5: net +0.5c, CI [-0.7,+1.8] straddles zero - matches literature (top-5 not soft). Do not trade.
rejected.outright_winner: efficient + maker fees + institutional MM (0.2c spreads). Benchmark only, per GOLF_KALSHI_RESEARCH.md.
